name: Azumi Ritsu
source:
The daughter of a family who own a Japanese-style inn renowned for its food, located in the countryside along the coast.
Cheerful and family-oriented, Ritsu's the eldest sister among three. As she's been helping her busy parents since she was a child, she hopes to take over the inn eventually. Ritsu can complete any domestic chore in general. Her cooking is self-taught but she has inherited her father's (who's a chef) flavouring.

[Translation of [URL=http://www.otomate.jp/tengai/chara/c0.php]official website profile[/URL].]
